story.originalTitle: “Fairness and integrity” of F1 at stake as FIA set to rule on Monaco controversy
story.summaryEn: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said the team's appeal against the Monaco Grand Prix result stems from concern for "the integrity of the sport". On Tuesday, the FIA's International Court of Appeal will hear appeals by McLaren and Red Bull against June's Monaco Grand Prix result.
detailZh: “公平与诚信”——随着国际汽联即将就摩纳哥争议作出裁决，F1的这些价值观正面临考验
F1正在等待迈凯伦和红牛就摩纳哥大奖赛结果发起的上诉程序的裁决结果
迈凯伦F1车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉表示，车队对摩纳哥大奖赛结果提出的上诉（将于周二举行），源于对“这项运动诚信”的担忧。
周二，国际汽联国际上诉法院正在审理迈凯伦和红牛针对六月份摩纳哥大奖赛结果提出的上诉。在那场比赛中，多名车手因超出维修区限速而被处以时间处罚，其中包括迈凯伦的奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里（皮亚斯特里）和阿尔派车手皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利）。
事后查明，那些进站通道违规信号是误报，起因是摩纳哥独特的进站入口起点处计时线圈出错。除以及他的阿尔派队友科拉平托之外，所有车手都已在比赛中服完了时间处罚，而这位法国车手则在终点线被处以双重五秒加时处罚，使他从第三名降至第七名。
在阿尔派对Gasly的处罚提出复审申请后，干事们撤销了两项处罚，并恢复了这位法国车手的领奖台位置，这使红牛队的哈贾尔降至第四名，同时也将迈凯伦的Piastri的排名往后挤了。
结果，迈凯伦和红牛双双启动了上诉程序，因为他们对Gasly的处罚被撤销一事有异议，而包括Piastri在内的其他车手却没有这样的机会。
在听证会召开之前——听证会将于周二进行，但可能会拖得更久——迈凯伦老板Stella表示，车队既是在维护自身在车队积分榜上的利益，也是在维护这项赛事整体的利益。
安德烈亚·斯特拉表示"这项运动的公正性"正处于危险之中
"我们将带着双重目的出席国际上诉法院的听证会," 斯特拉在周日荷兰大奖赛后说道。"第一个目的比迈凯伦的利益更为宽泛。我们认为摩纳哥大奖赛之后所发生的程序需要被重新审视, 因为从对所有参赛者的公平性来看, 处罚被撤销这一事实引入了一些令人严重担忧的因素。我们希望借助国际上诉法院的机会, 对这一方面作出澄清。
"显然, 这个案件还有更多关联之处。它可以涉及维修区限速器速度如何计算等技术层面的问题。但对我而言, 从更高的层面来看, 更需要澄清的其实是公平性和原则, 并有可能将其重新确立。"
他补充道: "第二个方面是我们迈凯伦自身的利益。我们实际上也因执行了一次不可上诉的处罚而受到了损害。这让我们在锦标赛中损失了积分。
"因此，这不仅关系到一级方程式和这项运动诚信的普遍利益，也关系到迈凯伦在锦标赛成绩方面的实质利益。这是两个出发点、两种视角，我们希望在国际上诉法院即将进行的审理中就此寻求澄清。"
detailEn: “Fairness and integrity” of F1 at stake as FIA set to rule on Monaco controversy
Formula 1 is awaiting the outcome of the appeal procedure McLaren and Red Bull initiated against the result of the Monaco Grand Prix
McLaren Formula 1 team principal Andrea Stella says its appeal against the Monaco Grand Prix result, which is being held on Tuesday, stems from its concern for "the integrity of the sport".

On Tuesday, the FIA's International Court of Appeal is handling an appeal by McLaren and Red Bull against the result of June's Monaco Grand Prix, in which several drivers were handed time penalties for exceeding pitlane speed limits, including McLaren's Oscar Piastri and Alpine driver Pierre Gasly.

Afterwards, it emerged those pitlane infractions were false flags, caused by a timing loop error at the start of Monaco's unique pit entry. All drivers, other than Gasly (and his Alpine team-mate Franco Colapinto), had already served their time penalties during the race, while the Frenchman was handed a double five-second time penalty at the flag, demoting him from third to seventh.

After Alpine launched a Right of Review against Gasly's penalties, the stewards rescinded both and restored the Frenchman's podium berth, which demoted Red Bull's Isack Hadjar to fourth and also bumped McLaren's Piastri down the order.
As a result, both McLaren and Red Bull launched an appeal procedure, because they took issue with Gasly's penalty being rescinded while other drivers, including Piastri, had no such opportunity.

Anticipating the hearing, which takes place across Tuesday but could potentially drag on for longer, McLaren boss Stella said the team was both looking after its own interest in the constructors' standings and the interest of the series in general.
Andrea Stella says the "integrity of the sport" is at stake

"We go to the hearing at the International Court of Appeal with a double intent," Stella said on Sunday after the Dutch Grand Prix. "The first intent is more general than the interest of McLaren. We think that the process that happened after the race in Monaco needs to be reviewed because from fairness for all competitors, the fact that the penalty was removed introduces some significant elements of concern. And we would like to take the opportunity of the International Court of Appeal for a clarification of this aspect.

"There's obviously more related to this case. It can go into the technical aspects of how the pit limiter speed was calculated. But for me, at a high level, it's more the fairness and the principle that needs to be clarified and possibly reinstated."
He added: "The second aspect is the interest of McLaren ourselves. We were also materially penalised for having served a penalty that is not appealable. And this cost us points in the championship.

"So, there's a general interest for Formula 1 and the integrity of the sport. And there's a material interest for McLaren in terms of our championship impact. These are the two points of view, the two perspectives that we would like to pursue and seek clarification for in the coming International Court of Appeal."

detailZh: 丹尼尔·里卡多在美国大奖赛前夕的现场表演令F1粉丝感到惊喜
前F1车手丹尼尔·里卡多与音乐家罗布·贝尔德一起吹奏口琴，令粉丝感到惊喜
丹尼尔·里卡多，Drive to Survive第七季
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
前一级方程式车手丹尼尔·里卡多在美国德克萨斯州奥斯汀的舞台上出现了一个惊喜。
这位澳大利亚人与歌手兼词曲作者罗布·贝尔德一起加入了福特赛车和Enchanté快闪活动，在周五晚上一起演奏他与美国大奖赛旅途中共创作的原创歌曲。
一位粉丝在Instagram上发布的表演视频，截至写作时已经获得了超过7000个赞。一位粉丝评论说：“这治愈了我心中的某一部分，”另一位粉丝补充说：“我敢打赌他上辈子要么是鲍勃·迪伦的兄弟，要么是个牛仔哈哈。我们爱你，丹尼尔。”
“在这个时候，没有人关心比赛。很高兴看到丹尼尔回来了，即使他不再赛车，”另一位粉丝写道，另一位粉丝写道：“作为一个音乐家和蜜獾粉丝，和丹尼·里卡多一起演奏是我的梦想。”
“我是说真的很长的一段路。沙漠、乡村小道、游泳洞，所有这些。说实话，我迫不及待了。”
这次长途旅行是推广新系列 Enchanté Collection 的活动之一，名为《长途》。这些新产品在奥斯汀的 Distribution Hall 的临时展位上出售，展位上还有食品、饮料、闪粉纹身和赛车模拟器。
里卡多也被看到在支持 小红牛 车队的车手利亚姆·劳森，作为新西兰人，他在 Esses Bazaar ATX 活动中担任主角，与利亚姆·劳森和朋友们一起在东第六街的 Inn Cahoots 举办车库音乐会，此次活动是为本周末的美国大奖赛做准备。
detailEn: Daniel Ricciardo surprises F1 fans with on-stage performance ahead of US GP
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo surprised fans with a harmonica performance alongside musician Rob Baird
Daniel Ricciardo , Drive to Survive Season 7
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Former Formula 1 driver Daniel Ricciardo made a surprise appearance on stage in Austin, Texas, with American singer-songwriter Rob Baird.
The Australian joined Baird at the Ford Racing and Enchanté pop-up on Friday night to play harmonica on an original song he co-wrote with Baird during a road trip to the United States Grand Prix.

A fan video of the performance, posted on Instagram, had picked up more than 7000 likes by the time of writing. "This healed something in me," one fan commented, while another added: "I'm sure he was either Bob Dylan's brother or a cowboy in a previous life lol. We love you, Daniel."

"At this point, no one cares about the race. Glad to see Daniel back, even if he’s not racing," someone else posted, and another fan wrote: "As a musician and a honey badger fan, it would be a dream to play with Danny Ric."
"And I mean the lonnnng way. Desert, backroads, swimming holes, all of it. Not gonna lie, I can't wait."

The road trip was part of the promotion of the new Enchanté collection, The Long Road. The new products are being sold at a pop-up at Distribution Hall in Austin alongside food, drinks, flash tattoos and racing simulators.

Ricciardo was also spotted supporting Racing Bulls driver Liam Lawson as the New Zealander headlined Garage Sessions with Liam Lawson and Friends as part of Esses Bazaar ATX, held at Inn Cahoots on East Sixth Street ahead of this weekend's United States Grand Prix.

detailZh: 尼科·胡肯伯格在美国大奖赛上被加布里埃尔·博特洛托恶作剧后颜面扫地
加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美国大奖赛期间的一次粉丝见面会上玩了一个意外的恶作剧，让他的奥迪车队队友笑得前仰后合
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和那些让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事
年轻的奥迪车手加布里埃尔·博特洛托在美洲赛道前与队友尼科·胡肯伯格走在一起时，对他进行了一次恶作剧。两位车手在奥斯汀观众的欢呼声中走出，巴西人拉下了队友的裤子。
这个时刻的视频已经迅速走红，展示了胡肯伯格在周五如何走上舞台，当时博尔特洛从后面抓住他的裤子并将其拉下，引发了观众的欢呼和笑声。这位德国人对此玩笑表示宽容，一边笑着一边整理好衣服。
这个恶作剧为博尔特洛艰难的周末带来了一些轻松。巴西人在周日美国大奖赛将从最后一排发车，因为奥迪为他提供的动力单元组件超出了分配额度。
博尔特洛和胡肯伯格自2025年以来一直是队友，当时车队还以萨博的身份参赛，尽管车队已被德国巨头奥迪接管，但他们成为了赛场上更为轻松的搭档之一。然而，车队在2026年很难获得积分。车队在车队积分榜上排名第八，积分为23分，胡肯伯格积13分，博尔特洛积10分。
博尔特洛在美国大奖赛周末赛前表示：“我在可靠性方面看到了很多改进。显然，我们在新加坡显然有一个问题，我们相信我们已经找到了原因。”
“这显然不是理想的情况，但与此同时，它发生的时候我并没有在前面真正地竞争，所以这让我对它稍微不那么沮丧。但我希望我们能够在接下来的赛季中没有任何重大问题，并且能够以最佳状态完成比赛和排位赛，驾驶我们能够驾驶的最好的汽车，从中提取一切。”
detailEn: Nico Hulkenberg left red-faced after Gabriel Bortoleto prank at United States GP
Gabriel Bortoleto left his Audi team-mate laughing after pulling an unexpected prank during a fan appearance at the United States Grand Prix
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Young Audi driver Gabriel Bortoleto played a prank on his team-mate Nico Hulkenberg as the pair walked out in front of thousands of fans at the Circuit of the Americas. With both drivers walking out to cheers from the Austin crowds, the Brazilian pulled down his team-mate's trousers.

Videos of this moment have gone incredibly viral, showing Hulkenberg making his way onto the stage on Friday when Bortoleto grabbed his trousers from behind and pulled them down, to loud cheers and laughter from the crowd. The German took the joke in good humour, laughing as he pulled his clothes straight.

The prank offered some light relief on a tough weekend for Bortoleto. The Brazilian will start Sunday’s United States Grand Prix from the back of the grid, after Audi took him beyond his allocation of power unit components.

Bortoleto and Hulkenberg have been team-mates since 2025, when the team still raced as Sauber, and have formed one of the more light-hearted partnerships on the grid despite it being taken over by German giant Audi. The outfit has found points hard to come by in 2026, however. The team is eighth in the constructors’ championship on 23 points, with the experienced Hulkenberg on 13 and Bortoleto on 10.

"I have seen lots of improvement on reliability," Bortoleto said on Thursday ahead of the United States Grand Prix race weekend. "I think we had one [issue] in Singapore obviously, that we believe we found the reason of.

"It was obviously something not ideal to happen, but at the same time it happened when I was not really fighting at the front, so made me a little bit less upset about it. But I hope we are able to do the rest of the season without having any major issue and that we are able to just complete the races and qualifying in the best condition and the best car possible out there that we can drive and extract everything from it."

relatedItems.originalTitle: Why Cadillac F1 boss provoked fresh intrigue by dodging driver question
detailZh: 为什么凯迪拉克F1负责人通过回避车手问题引发新的好奇
关于瓦尔特里·博塔斯在凯迪拉克未来去向的猜测持续存在，因为车队正打算引入一名美国车手
马辛·布德科夫斯基，凯迪拉克车队负责人
美国大奖赛周末自然意味着聚光灯转向了F1的两支美国车队。这也导致凯迪拉克在对其2027年及以后车手阵容的猜测中面临了一些尴尬的问题。
Sergio Perez和Valtteri Bottas都签订了“多年”合同，据说是所谓的“一年加一年”安排，其中第二年是否续约是可选的，取决于双方满足各种条件。两位车手之间的表现差异如此之大，以至于Bottas的位置已经成为了几个月来车队的八卦话题。
最近任命的团队负责人Marcin Budkowski已经不得不对此进行一些灭火工作，他的前任Graeme Lowdon也是如此。但周五在奥斯汀举行的FIA车队代表新闻发布会上的一个相当奇特的时刻表明，凯迪拉克的计划并不像之前宣传的那样固定。
引发这一事件的催化剂是来自一位广播员的关于Perez即将迎来第300场大奖赛起跑的软问题：“评价一个在网格后部战斗的车手有多难，同时他给人的印象是比队友有更好的赛季表现？关于车手，你们有兴趣就也许的预备角色与Esteban [奥康]进行任何对话吗？”
在试图给出一个合适的含糊其辞的答案时，Budkowski开始感到困惑。
“看，对于一个像Checo这样的车手，正如你所说，他有着丰富的经验和许多比赛，我可以告诉你，他并不像任何接近退休的车手那样表现或驾驶，”他说。
“他在驾驶座上非常努力。他在幕后也非常努力地推动我们，在简报室和外面，他经常给我和其他团队成员发短信，推动我们进步。他渴望胜利，他充满动力，这实际上是非常好的。他以自己的风格做到这一点。
“我们有两名车手：一个可能更热情，另一个可能更冷静，如果我们可以这样说的。他们都以自己独特的方式推动车队，但Checo确实是在非常努力地推动我们。仅从他在起跑线上的身体语言来看，当他戴上头盔，坐进车里，他正在为战斗做准备。那里充满了激情，充满了动力，对于一个经验丰富的车手来说，这确实是非常令人印象深刻的。
“同时，我们也在从他的反馈和作为一名经验丰富的车手的角度获取他的意见。所以，是的，这是一个非常好的组合。
“很抱歉，第二个问题是关于埃斯特班·奥康的？嗯，看吧，作为一个车队负责人，我相信我的同事也是一样，你会接到来自市场上每一位车手或车手经理的电话和联系。所以，有很多车手和经理已经联系了我。
“我不会说是谁或不是谁，但几乎所有在市场上的人都已经联系过了，正如你所预期的。但是，是的，我想这是最后一个地方，正如你可以想象的那样，我不会在这里传达任何关于车手阵容的信息。
如果威廉·莎士比亚在场，毫无疑问他会拿起羽毛笔在羊皮纸上划掉一条笔记，表示这位绅士过于抗议。幸运的是，对于凯迪拉克车队负责人来说，也许，阿德里安·纽维在场，并成为了后续大多数问题的自然磁铁。
Motorsport.com了解到，奥康几乎不可能加入凯迪拉克，因为他和佩雷斯在上一次同处一室时就像油和水一样不相容。据信他可能会成为阿斯顿·马丁的第三位车手。
凯迪拉克是否会在2027年保留博塔斯，目前尚不清楚，但众所周知，车队老板希望尽快有一位美国车手坐在赛车座位上。洛夫顿今年夏天的意外替代者表明，通用汽车和TWG赛车运动公司的期望似乎领先于车队目前的进展。
凯迪拉克在美洲赛车场的自由练习1中使用了科尔顿·赫塔，但他由于国际汽联改变了资格赛规则，只差一分未能获得超级驾照，因此他成为任何比赛机会的左翼候选人。如果他今年在其他练习中能有有意义的驾驶表现，他将获得资格——但他在本赛季的F2赛事表现相当不稳定，并不是一张很强的名片。
“显然，在美国车队中有美国车手是一个很好的故事，”布德科维茨在本周末对天空体育说。
“这需要是正确的时间和正确的车手。但我们正在努力。我们正在和科尔顿一起努力。
“有一些真正令人兴奋的美国新秀正在崛起。我们看到了Ugo Ugochukwu赢得了F3冠军。我们还有Sebastian Wheldon将在明年进入F3。”
““所以这里有很多潜力，我们当然会去调查。”"
detailEn: Why Cadillac F1 boss provoked fresh intrigue by dodging driver question
Speculation continues to surround the future of Valtteri Bottas at Cadillac as the team looks to bring on an American driver
Marcin Budkowski, Cadillac Team Principal

The US GP weekend naturally means the spotlight gravitates towards Formula 1’s two American-owned teams. That has led to some awkward questions for Cadillac amid ongoing speculation over its driver line-up for 2027 and beyond.

Both Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas are on “multi-year” contracts, understood to be a so-called one-plus-one arrangement in which the second year is optional, subject to either party fulfilling various conditions. Such has been the disparity in performance between the two drivers that Bottas’s position has been the object of paddock gossip for months.

Recently appointed team principal Marcin Budkowski has already had to do some firefighting on this, as had his predecessor Graeme Lowdon. But a rather peculiar moment in the FIA’s press conference for team representatives on Friday in Austin suggested Cadillac’s plans aren’t as fixed as previously billed.

The catalyst was a soft question from one of the broadcasters on the theme of Perez’s upcoming 300th grand prix start: “How difficult is it to evaluate a driver who’s fighting at the back of the grid, at the same time as the impression is that he’s having a better season than his team-mate? And quickly on drivers, would you be interested in having any conversation with Esteban [Ocon] regarding maybe a reserve role?”
In trying to give a suitably anodyne non-answer, Budkowski began to flounder.

“Look, for a driver like Checo, who, as you said, has a huge amount of experience and a number of races, I can tell you he doesn’t behave or drive like a driver who is anywhere close to retirement,” hew said.

“He’s pushing very hard behind the wheel. He’s pushing us very hard also behind the scenes, in the debrief rooms and outside, and regularly texting me and other members of the team to push us to improve. He’s hungry, he’s motivated, and that’s actually really good to see. He does it in his own style.

“We have two drivers: one is more hot and one is probably more cold, if we could say, from there. And they both push the team in their own particular ways, but Checo is, yes, pushing us very hard. And just looking at the way his body language on the grid, when he gets his helmet on and he gets in the car, he’s getting ready for a fight. There’s a lot of fire, there’s a lot of motivation there, so it’s really impressive for a driver of this experience.
“And at the same time, we’re getting his feedback and his input in terms of, as an experienced driver. So yes, it’s a very good combination.

“And sorry, the second question was about Esteban Ocon? Well, look, as a team principal, and I’m sure it’s the same with my colleagues, you’re getting calls and contacts from every driver or driver manager that is on the market. So, there are a number of drivers and managers who have contacted me.

“I’m not going to say who it is or who it isn’t, but pretty much all of them that are on the market have been in touch, as you’d expect. But yes, I think it’s the last place here, as you can imagine, where I would communicate anything on driver line-up.”

Were William Shakespeare present, he would no doubt have put quill to parchment and scratched out a note to the effect that the gentleman doth protest too much. Fortunately for the Cadillac team principal, perhaps, Adrian Newey was in the room and acted as a natural magnet for the majority of further questions.

Motorsport.com understands that Ocon is highly unlikely to go to Cadillac, since he and Perez mixed like oil and water when they last coexisted under the same roof. It’s believed he will probably become Aston Martin’s third driver.

Whether or not Cadillac retain Bottas for 2027, it’s known that the team’s owners wish to have an American driver in a race seat as soon as possible. Lowdon’s surprise replacement this summer is an indication of how General Motors and TWG Motorsports’ expectations appear to be running somewhere ahead of the team’s current progress.

Cadillac ran Colton Herta in FP1 at the Circuit of The Americas, but he is a leftfield candidate for any race opportunities since he is one point short of qualifying for a superlicence, owing to the FIA having changed the qualifying rubric. If he has meaningful running in another session this year he will qualify – but his rather patchy Formula 2 campaign this season isn’t a very strong calling card.
“Obviously having an American driver in an American team is a great story,” Budkowski told Sky Sports this weekend.
“It needs to be the right time and the right driver. But we're working on that. We're working on that with Colton.
“There are some really exciting American talents coming up through the ranks as well. We've seen Ugo Ugochukwu winning F3. We've got [Sebastian] Wheldon coming through to F3 next year.
“So there's a lot of potential here and we'll look into that obviously.”
